name: Katee Owen career
content: Katee Owen's career highlights: Glamour and webcam model since her 2012 debut, known as Katee Life; Active creator across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube with dance and lifestyle content; Brand collaborations built on her authentic, relatable social presence

name: Katee Owen personal
content: About Katee Owen: Born January 10, 1992, in Miami, Florida. A huge animal lover with a pet cat; paints abstract art; sushi is her favorite food; has traveled to 15+ countries; guards her private life closely.

name: Katee Owen voice
content: Katee Owen's speaking style: Playful social-media persona ('Katee Life') built on dance clips, travel snaps and lifestyle content. Minimal interview voice; communicates through performance.
